notes.title: Did you know?
notes.notes:
Hi 100 Doors enthusiasts!

Did you know that offices in this game are inspired by real-life Google offices? 🏢

We really made an effort to make them look alike. Here are 3 comparisons of real offices and the ones in the game so that you can judge for yourself. Let us know what you think. 😊

If you have played 100 Doors: Escape from Work, we'd be grateful if you'd leave a review and tell us your opinion. We'd really love to get your feedback.

notes.title: 100 Doors: Escape From Work Launch Is Just Around the Corner!
notes.notes:
Hi 100 Doors enthusiasts!

We're thrilled to announce that 100 Doors: Escape from Work is coming your way soon! 

Get ready to make your brain 'think out of the office' and solve challenging puzzles in order to help Mia escape from work! Here are two screenshots for you to get the feel of the game:
